notes.title: Update: Added Beautiful Swimsuit Illustrations！
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963167/0199e283a3d1a4841223441e303b572cfce8a690.jpg[/img]
1、Fixed a performance issue, reducing the memory usage after loading the game.

2、Resolved the issue where HexBlade could not use enchantment skills such as “Flame Enchantment”.

3、Reduced the repetitive labor in the “Harvest Season” event. Now it only takes a very short time and fewer clicks to complete the event, while also increasing its rewards.

4、Added a static swimsuit illustration and a dynamic swimsuit illustration for “Lucia”. The static swimsuit illustration is available in all versions, while the dynamic version is only an update reward for the deluxe edition. 
(You can find the illustration in the img/pictures folder of the game directory and use it as a wallpaper at your discretion)

5、After completing a mission, the teammate's morale will no longer decrease
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963167/6d78971665771f18760c6ecaa98231f21dc2e3ee.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Domain Power、illustration、challenges
notes.content:
[b]New Domain Power【Hex Blade】[/b]
A mysterious soul resides in your weapon,
and curses and heavily strikes your enemies.


[b]illustration：[/b]
A new dynamic illustration "Spring Festival" (can be used unconditionally) has been added, 
corresponding to the character "Huiying".

[b]Challenges[/b]
A new mission "Enemies from Other Worlds" (appears after completion) has been added. 
After entering, you will choose a group of special enemies to fight at the end point. 
Currently, four different challenges have been created.

[b]Features：[/b]
The dock has added a "trade" function, where you can trade between money and loot, and the exchange rate and trading volume will fluctuate with the size of the territory and the number of docks. 

A "quick equip" function has been added, and the system will directly change the equipment according to the equipment values (however, if you want to carefully configure and reasonably arrange certain ideas, you still need to configure manually).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963167/2465fd269aa92224c5a774aa2c6b7f559c6508c7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963167/9094862321809145dd31098fcfdb68ee46db1809.png[/img]

Thank you very much for your support of this game! As for my personal development, the support of players is my most important creative motivation. I hope that in 2025, everyone can overcome difficulties and become better.

notes.title: Farm buildings have been strengthened!
notes.content:
Farm buildings have been strengthened! 
Now you can plant crops that yield various rewards within them.

notes.title: Promotion Discount Now Live!
notes.content: The new discount has begun, and the game has undergone various updates, including performance optimizations, added settings, new illustrations, and more. We hope you enjoy playing!

notes.title: Improve GPU mode
notes.content:
Feel free to post any questions in the Steam discussion area, 
and I will provide assistance as soon as possible!

I have enhanced the GPU optimization feature in the settings. When enabled, 
it can significantly reduce the game's configuration requirements, especially for GPU rendering.

I have increased the benefits from Temple donations.

If you encounter performance issues, please give it a try! (White screen, unsmooth operation)
Please try:

Option → Reduce Weather Particles：ON、Improve GPU：ON 



This might be due to not being assigned to high performance mode. 

Please try the following steps:

1. Open NVIDIA Control Panel.

2. Go to 'Manage 3D settings'.

3. In the 'Program Settings' tab, find or add a program named 'game.exe'.

4. Set it to use the high-performance graphics processor by default.

After completing these steps, please restart the program.

AMD: For AMD graphics cards, set the game to 'High Performance' in AMD Radeon.

Windows 11 Integrated Graphics: In Windows 11 settings, find 'Display Adapter', 

click on 'App Custom Options', then select 'Add an app', 

browse and select the game shortcut on the desktop, and set it to 'High Performance Mode' (if you can directly search for 'game.exe', there is no need to add it).



Another method of setting: Change the resolution to the lowest within the game and then close the game. In Steam, right-click on the game and select "Browse Local Files." In the opened folder, find the game.exe file, right-click it, select Properties, go to the Compatibility tab, and check the box for "Run this program in compatibility mode for." Run the game in windowed or full-screen mode, which can significantly reduce the occurrence of white screens.

Drawback: You will need to right-click on game.exe and recheck the compatibility mode each time you reopen the game.

notes.title: Updated！New dynamic illustrations！New little story
notes.content:
Updated Content:

Two new dynamic illustrations have been added for DLC content (free update), 
featuring the characters "Mia·Seraphim" and "Elysia" with free trials available.
(Tip:Some dynamic backgrounds have other versions, 
which can be triggered by clicking the "!" button in the bottom right corner!)

A new character story, "Continuation of Fate,"
has been introduced. Upon entering this story, 
selecting characters with "Favorability >=10 and without a ★ mark" will trigger corresponding subplots. 
To date, subplots for five characters have been completed. 

(Additional subplots can be added in the future, and you can also write and read them by following the format and modifying the update.json file in the languages folder!)

Now you can get more props by fishing.

Enhance skills (modify action consumption、Modified animation)：Brute（Throw）

☆Hopeful Revival：Now it can be used on teammates who are on the brink of death
☆Time Rewind：Can also restore an additional 10% HP

notes.title: 军队任务 难度调整
notes.content:
每次刷新次要任务，必定出现一个军事行动。

降低军事行动一星单挑战的难度。

然后增加军事行动的更加复杂的曲线判断，而不是单纯的根据影响升级来，在你的地块达到一定数量之前，
即使你的影响升级上去了，军事行动的敌人也不会被增强。
（遭到攻城时也适用）

notes.title: 近期更新内容整理
notes.content:
有任何问题欢迎在steam讨论区，或者加玩家群515025290交流，
作者大部分时候都在线提供相关帮助~！

[b](11/21~23日)[/b]
预告冬促前更新内容（预计在冬促前一周到两周实装）：
新的动态主题和追加一些非带星角色的插曲剧情。

修复了玩家在舌战中，被论破时弱点没有清空的问题。
修复了主界面最小化、分辨率会变回默认的问题。
增强MOD接口和增加MOD角色出错时自动修复相关判定。

[b](11/14 ~ 11/15)[/b]
修改了随着地形切换的音乐效果，现在每个地形只对应一首音乐了，
主城根据意见采纳仍然是保持随机音乐。

主界面的书本不再总是显示new

进攻敌人军队时，将弹出敌人军队的兵力状态和最大兵力

修BUG

同时，对一些MOD玩家和MOD作者道歉，游戏首发后需要微调的东西和更新频率实在是有些多了，
影响到了MOD方面的体验，我也正在努力使游戏快速进入一个稳定、更好体验的版本，
而且也对即使不是MOD玩家、因此感到烦恼、有负面体验的玩家也说一声抱歉。
游戏会在12月冬促前免费更新，加入新的动态到豪华版中（秋促因为首发特殊冷却无法参与）

[b](11/13)[/b]
最新版本在战斗中使用各种技能的时候，可以看到更加详细的信息。

例如，强度基于力量(50)，会将你的对应强度DC写在括号中，
而例如交涉、辨识敌人、逃跑这类需要检定的互动动作中，
战斗时则会直接将成功率写在技能说明中。（例如，成功范围：70%）

命中技能则会计算出当前角色的命中率、buff命中、技能命中最后写上
（但无法做到再直接减去飞行、隐形、分身等效果带来的敌人闪避增幅）

[b](11/12)[/b]
优化了游戏的性能，现在游戏的占用率应该会变小（尤其是在高性能电脑上比较明显），
以及是在最小化游戏窗口的情况下会更为显著，有什么新的情况请及时汇报

同时增加了检测已经被卸载的MOD角色相关代码，
如果检测到为空的mod额外角色会自动移除避免报错。
(例如解决了在装上MOD角色后又卸载MOD读档时，显示缺失Actor25.png文件的报错)

补充一下mod遇到问题的解决方案：
不确定动了哪些文件，就把游戏目录删的只剩下save文件夹(存档文件）
后重装游戏(或者检测完整性等)
实在不行就加群找作者和mod作者

[b](11/9)[/b]
现在可以定制所有的装备类型（包括防具和饰品）
各种奇怪甚至极限的装备都可以出现了！

[b](11/8)[/b]
最新版本中，和BOSS、或者类似于BOSS的敌人交战时，
可以在名字下方看到其六维属性。

[b](11/7)[/b]
新增了通过计算时间来自动增长放置奖励累计的功能（与原本的挂机奖励是独立存在的），
也受到产能影响，离线仍然生效可以获得相关奖励、在线游玩也可以随时间获得这个奖励。

之前的版本并不会立刻获得奖励（因为没有记录这个变量），
需要启动游戏一次后，才能开始计算时间收益。

[b](11/6)[/b]
从这个版本开始，大部分强敌BOSS都会掉落英雄的记忆（等级上限提升道具）

进行“舌战”（辩论战）中的斗志、也就是HP算法改成了使用风度计算的生命值，
而不是使用体魄计算的了，避免了出现风度人在社交战斗中高攻低防的情况

在配置界面选人的时候，可以在属性后面看到潜能

在买卖东西的+10、-10道具数量中，现在会随着点击次数指数增长

降低了舌战难度，通过社交检定后，可以直接获得5个全部选项

现在可以在感悟兑换中，兑换凑各种套装功能性的专长、同时英雄记忆感悟价格下调至3000

修BUG

[b](11/5)[/b]
优化了使用各种“武器箱”、“装备箱”时播放的动画、增加开装备的快捷度，
未出三星的情况下将不再播放动画，即使出现三星的情况下、如果拥有的箱子超过5个，那么也不会播放动画（即在大量使用的情况下，只有最后一组才会播放动画）

[b](11/4)[/b]
目前在装备界面中，可以直接看到装备的星级

修复了一个问题，在特定情况下（可用地块较少）、不管影响多高都只能遇到一星军团战，
这个问题已经得到修复。（包括敌人进攻时的军队数量也有这个影响），
正常的判定应该是当兵力大于一定数额且季度大于5、影响升级过后，就能遇到二星以上的敌人军队了。

显著提升“等级加成”的数值，间接加强了使用武器攻击的流派，
间接提升了随着等级成长的伤害下限，也算进一步提升强化武器后的上限。

在领域界面的左侧加入了一行提示，提示可以通过右上角按钮前往技能界面

修BUG

[b](11/3)[/b]
队伍人数超过15名时，使用蝶将不再播放动画。

使用的千古秘典数量大于5时，将不再播放动画

通过辨识敌人或者教程的重创打击查询，可以看到所有伤害类型和对应图标

首次设置自动战斗会把战斗风格默认改成“自由”而不是原本的“节约”。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963167/60f2298159c80bdf24fbd3b0e32bf95c0d706c13.jpg[/img]
If you encounter performance issues, please give it a try! (White screen, unsmooth operation)

This might be due to not being assigned to high performance mode. 
Please try the following steps:
1. Open NVIDIA Control Panel.

2. Go to 'Manage 3D settings'.

3. In the 'Program Settings' tab, find or add a program named 'game.exe'.

4. Set it to use the high-performance graphics processor by default.

After completing these steps, please restart the program.

AMD: For AMD graphics cards, set the game to 'High Performance' in AMD Radeon.

Windows 11 Integrated Graphics: In Windows 11 settings, find 'Display Adapter', 

click on 'App Custom Options', then select 'Add an app', 

browse and select the game shortcut on the desktop, and set it to 'High Performance Mode' (if you can directly search for 'game.exe', there is no need to add it).

If the issue persists, such as using a low-performance integrated graphics card, please try:

If you encounter performance issues, please give it a try! (White screen, unsmooth operation)

This might be due to not being assigned to high performance mode. 
Please try the following steps:
1. Open NVIDIA Control Panel.

2. Go to 'Manage 3D settings'.

3. In the 'Program Settings' tab, find or add a program named 'game.exe'.

4. Set it to use the high-performance graphics processor by default.

After completing these steps, please restart the program.
